assumptions: All timestamps are timezone-naive and treated as UTC.
Severity: critical = record unusable for its core purpose; warning = fixable/flaggable; info = observation.
rows_affected counts rows in the raw file; one row can fail several checks.

checks.description: Row is an exact copy of an earlier row (same shipment_id and all fields).
checks.recommended_action: drop: keep the first copy, drop the rest (no information lost).

checks.description: shipment_id repeats with different field values (e.g. weight or cargo differs).
checks.detection: shipment_id duplicated but full row not duplicated.
checks.recommended_action: fix: keep the most complete record per id (fewest blanks, tie -> first seen), drop the rest, flag the kept row.

checks.description: origin_port or destination_port not in the ports reference (e.g. XXTST, ZZZZZ, UNKNW placeholders).
checks.detection: Referential integrity: port code NOT IN ports.port_code.
checks.recommended_action: quarantine: route metrics and the model cannot use a shipment without real ports.

checks.description: cargo_type differs from the canonical label only by case/whitespace (e.g. 'FURNITURE', ' Chemicals').
checks.detection: Raw value != whitespace-collapsed, case-insensitive match to the canonical list.
checks.recommended_action: fix: normalize to the canonical label.

checks.description: cargo_type does not match any canonical category even after normalization.
checks.detection: Normalized value NOT IN canonical cargo list.
checks.recommended_action: flag: keep raw value, review mapping.

checks.description: cargo_type is blank.
checks.recommended_action: fix: set to 'Unknown' so the record stays usable; model treats it as its own category.

checks.description: weight_tons is blank.
checks.recommended_action: flag: keep NULL (no defensible fill value); the model imputes the training median.

checks.description: weight_tons < 0, which is physically impossible.
checks.recommended_action: fix: set to NULL and flag (sign-flip is a guess we should not make silently).

checks.description: container_count is 0 (or negative) for a booked shipment.
checks.recommended_action: fix: set to NULL and flag.

checks.description: container_count above the robust upper fence (94); values here are ~15-25x the normal max.
checks.detection: IQR fence: count > Q3 + 3.0 * IQR on positive counts.
checks.recommended_action: fix: set to NULL and flag (likely unit/keying error, e.g. TEU vs containers or an extra digit).

checks.description: status outside {DELIVERED, DELAYED, CANCELLED}: 'COMPLETED', 'Complete', 'delivered', 'N/A', blank.
checks.detection: Raw value NOT IN canonical status set.
checks.recommended_action: fix: map completion variants to DELIVERED, blanks/'N/A' to UNKNOWN.

checks.description: Shipment is not CANCELLED but has no actual departure/arrival, so its delay cannot be computed.
checks.detection: status != CANCELLED AND (actual_departure blank OR actual_arrival blank).
checks.recommended_action: flag: keep the record (it is a real booking) but exclude it from delay metrics and ML labels.

checks.description: Vessel actually departed before the booking was made: temporally impossible.
checks.recommended_action: fix: set actual_departure to NULL and flag; arrival-based delay is kept.

checks.description: A non-blank timestamp that does not parse as YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS.
checks.detection: Strict format parse of every timestamp column.
checks.recommended_action: quarantine if present.

checks.description: booking_date / planned_departure / planned_arrival blank (needed for every metric and the model).
checks.detection: Blank check on required planning timestamps.
checks.recommended_action: quarantine if present.

checks.description: planned_arrival <= planned_departure, or booking_date after planned_departure.
checks.detection: Timeline order check on planned timestamps.
checks.recommended_action: quarantine if present.

checks.description: actual_arrival <= actual_departure.
checks.detection: Timeline order check on actual timestamps.
checks.recommended_action: flag and null actuals if present.

checks.description: origin_port == destination_port.
checks.recommended_action: flag if present.

checks.description: CANCELLED shipment that still has an actual arrival.
checks.detection: status == CANCELLED AND actual_arrival not blank.
checks.recommended_action: flag if present.

checks.description: status DELIVERED but delay > 24h, or DELAYED but delay <= 24h.
checks.detection: Cross-field consistency between status and computed arrival delay.
checks.recommended_action: flag if present (computed delay wins over the status label).

checks.description: country is blank (BEANR / Antwerp).
checks.recommended_action: fix: fill from the UN/LOCODE country prefix (BE -> Belgium).

checks.description: port_code appears more than once in the reference table.
checks.recommended_action: quarantine duplicates if present.

checks.description: avg_congestion_score missing or outside [0, 1].
checks.recommended_action: flag if present.

checks.description: event_id reused by different events (different port, vessel, time). All rows sharing an id are counted.
checks.detection: event_id duplicated(keep=False); rows are not exact duplicates.
checks.recommended_action: fix: keep all rows (they are distinct events), add a deterministic surrogate key, flag.

checks.description: Exact duplicate event rows (typical of at-least-once streaming delivery).
checks.recommended_action: drop duplicates if present.

checks.description: event_type is blank.
checks.recommended_action: fix: set to 'UNKNOWN' and keep the row (delay_minutes still usable).

checks.description: vessel_id not in the shipment fleet (VSL-0000 and VSL-9999 look like test/placeholder ids).
checks.detection: Referential integrity: vessel_id NOT IN shipments.vessel_id.
checks.recommended_action: quarantine: cannot be linked to any shipment.

checks.description: port_code not in the ports reference.
checks.recommended_action: quarantine if present.

checks.description: delay_minutes missing, non-numeric or negative.
checks.recommended_action: set to NULL and flag if present.

checks.description: event_type DELAYED but delay_minutes = 0 (contradictory).
checks.recommended_action: flag only: we cannot tell which field is wrong.

checks.description: event_timestamp blank or not parseable.
checks.recommended_action: quarantine if present.

checks.description: Free-text notes blank. Notes are optional, so this is informational.
checks.recommended_action: keep as NULL.
